title: High-Stakes Discussions

objectives: Use high-stakes risk communication to synthesize and reformulate ideas related to high-stakes discussions with appropriate C2 complexity.

stages.title: Understand meaning and form
stages.instructions: Read the concept, pattern, examples, contrast, common issue, and recap.

blocks.text: The communicative aim of this lesson is to use high-stakes risk communication to synthesize and reformulate ideas related to high-stakes discussions with appropriate C2 complexity. The central language focus is high-stakes risk communication. In the context of complex professional communication, form and meaning work together: first identify the relationship between the ideas, then choose wording that makes that relationship clear to another person. At C2 content level, control comes from flexible choices rather than rare vocabulary. Preserve subtle meaning while reframing, compressing, expanding, or shifting register, and make rhetorical effects deliberate rather than decorative.

blocks.explanation: This model establishes the main communicative move.

blocks.english: A clear explanation addresses high-stakes consequence directly.
blocks.explanation: This model develops or qualifies the message.

blocks.text: Start with the model “The discussion highlighted material risk.” It establishes a useful direction for the exchange. The second model, “A clear explanation addresses high-stakes consequence directly.” adds another layer: a reason, implication, contrast, or response. Notice how each complete chunk does a communicative job. Practice replacing one detail while preserving the original grammar, stance, and register. Then connect the revised sentence to a relevant consequence or example instead of changing topic abruptly.

A useful pattern for this lesson is: high-stakes risk communication. Use it when the situation genuinely calls for that meaning. Contrast matters: a direct factual statement presents information, while a qualified or hypothetical form changes the speaker's commitment to it. The choice should be driven by evidence, time reference, relationship, and purpose. In listening, pay attention not only to individual words but also to linkers, stress, and the speaker's degree of certainty.

blocks.title: Contrast
blocks.text: Compare a direct statement with language shaped by high-stakes risk communication; the intended meaning determines the form.

A common issue is to select an advanced-looking form without maintaining its meaning across the sentence. That can create a mismatch in time, stance, or register. Check three things: what happened or is being proposed, how certain the speaker is, and what response is expected. For high-stakes discussions, clarity comes from a coherent message rather than maximum complexity. The later stages recycle the same vocabulary and expressions so that recognition becomes controlled production and then flexible interaction.

blocks.title: Common issue
blocks.text: Do not add complexity that changes the time reference, degree of certainty, or relationship with the listener.

stages.title: Listen for meaning and stance
stages.instructions: Listen first, then reveal the text and notice connections, register, and emphasis.

segments.text: To begin with, The discussion highlighted material risk. A clear explanation addresses high-stakes consequence directly.
In this situation, A clear explanation addresses high-stakes consequence directly. The speaker emphasized escalation path.
From another perspective, The speaker emphasized escalation path. Our response should account for shared accountability.
More specifically, Our response should account for shared accountability. This example illustrates negotiating leverage clearly.
Even so, This example illustrates negotiating leverage clearly. We should consider package an agreement carefully.
As a result, We should consider package an agreement carefully. The discussion highlighted sensitive concern.
On reflection, The discussion highlighted sensitive concern. A clear explanation addresses preserve working relations directly.
Ultimately, A clear explanation addresses preserve working relations directly. The discussion highlighted material risk.
